sources.title: Argentina's transgender community confronts 'chaotic, desperate' situation
sources.claim_summary: Washington Blade feature (April 2025) on Argentina's trans community: Feb 2024 interviews at an LGBTQ cultural centre in downtown Buenos Aires; former national LGBTQ special envoy Alba Rueda says 'we are in a bad moment for the rights and quality of life of LGBTQ+ people'; documents the national rollbacks since Dec 2023 - abolition of the Women, Gender and Diversity Ministry, closure of INADI (the anti-discrimination institute), dismissal of government-hired trans workers under the Trans Labor Quota Law - plus the Gender Identity Law's ongoing framework. National context; no Chubut-specific incidents.

sources.title: Crímenes de odio en Argentina: aumento y récord de uno cada 38 horas - Agencia Presentes
sources.claim_summary: Agencia Presentes (19 March 2026), citing the Observatorio Nacional de Crimenes de Odio: 2025 was a record year - at least 227 hate crimes based on sexual orientation or gender identity, +62% vs the prior year, one every 38 hours; most perpetrators were security-force personnel or unknowns in public spaces, beatings the dominant modality; security-force violence against LGBTIQ+ people rose from 17 cases in 2024 to 64 in 2025; early 2026 includes the beating of a journalist in the Almagro neighbourhood, an attack on a comedian outside her radio station, the near-fatal attack on a LGBTIQ+ collective president at her Calilegua home (25 Jan), the murder of teacher Walter Daniel Aguirre (55) in Caballito, and police raids in Salta, Cordoba and Buenos Aires provinces (18-26 Nov 2025) around three LGBT+ deaths. National/provincial data; nothing Chubut-specific.

sources.title: Milei modified the Gender Identity Law by decree: what changed and why are they asking for judicial intervention? - Agencia Presentes
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (HTTP 500 from the origin); the underlying source covers the executive decree DNU 62/2025 amending the national Gender Identity Law (banning hormone and surgical transition treatments for under-18s) and a second decree on the placement of trans people in prisons - national-level changes applying to every unit alike.
